intro: I enjoy reading and reviewing books by fellow authors. If you'd like me to consider yours, tell me a little about it and upload the EPUB below.
openTo: Science fiction is my first choice: space opera, first contact, military, near-future
A romance B-story is a bonus. For romance, I prefer male/female pairings, especially in the male's point of view
Novels, published or not yet released
